policy_text: [Historical Q1 Policy] Employees must review the published annual enrollment window. Eligibility depends on active employment status and the selected benefits tier. Routine queries are answered directly; individual plan changes require submitting the benefits enrollment form to the Benefits team.

[Current Active Policy] Employees must review the published annual enrollment window. Eligibility depends on active employment status and the selected benefits tier. Routine queries are answered directly; individual plan changes require submitting the benefits enrollment form to the Benefits team.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Dependent coverage requests require supporting documentation such as marriage or birth certificates within 30 days of a qualifying life event. HR Benefits verifies all certificates before enrolling dependents.

[Current Active Policy] Dependent coverage requests require supporting documentation such as marriage or birth certificates within 30 days of a qualifying life event. HR Benefits verifies all certificates before enrolling dependents.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Mid-year benefits changes are permitted only following a verified qualifying life event (e.g. marriage, birth, or spouse coverage change). Documentation must be submitted within 30 days.

[Current Active Policy] Mid-year benefits changes are permitted only following a verified qualifying life event (e.g. marriage, birth, or spouse coverage change). Documentation must be submitted within 30 days.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Employees can download digital insurance cards directly from the insurer portal. Physical replacement cards may be requested through the Benefits portal and arrive within 7 to 10 business days.

[Current Active Policy] Employees can download digital insurance cards directly from the insurer portal. Physical replacement cards may be requested through the Benefits portal and arrive within 7 to 10 business days.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Full-time regular employees accrue 1.5 days of annual paid leave per month (up to 18 days annually). Leave requests must be submitted through the leave management portal at least 5 business days in advance and approved by the direct manager.

[Current Active Policy] Full-time regular employees accrue 1.5 days of annual paid leave per month (up to 18 days annually). Leave requests must be submitted through the leave management portal at least 5 business days in advance and approved by the direct manager.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Notification to the immediate manager is required by 09:00 AM on the day of absence. Medical certification is required for sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive business days.

[Current Active Policy] Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Notification to the immediate manager is required by 09:00 AM on the day of absence. Medical certification is required for sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive business days.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Current leave balances can be viewed anytime on the HR Employee Self-Service portal under 'Time & Absence'. The Helpdesk does not manually compute or modify balances without manager and HR approval.

[Current Active Policy] Current leave balances can be viewed anytime on the HR Employee Self-Service portal under 'Time & Absence'. The Helpdesk does not manually compute or modify balances without manager and HR approval.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Official public holidays are observed based on the primary work location indicated in the employee profile. Remote employees follow the statutory holidays of their contractual regional hub.

[Current Active Policy] Official public holidays are observed based on the primary work location indicated in the employee profile. Remote employees follow the statutory holidays of their contractual regional hub.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Salaries are disbursed on the final business day of each calendar month. If the final day falls on a weekend or public holiday, disbursement occurs on the preceding business day.

[Current Active Policy] Salaries are disbursed on the final business day of each calendar month. If the final day falls on a weekend or public holiday, disbursement occurs on the preceding business day.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Digital payslips are generated and accessible via the secure Payroll Self-Service portal 2 days prior to salary disbursement. Employees require active multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access payslip PDFs.

[Current Active Policy] Digital payslips are generated and accessible via the secure Payroll Self-Service portal 2 days prior to salary disbursement. Employees require active multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access payslip PDFs.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Reported salary discrepancies, deduction queries, or missing reimbursements require review by the Payroll team. The Helpdesk must never post employee compensation numbers or banking details in general queues.

[Current Active Policy] Reported salary discrepancies, deduction queries, or missing reimbursements require review by the Payroll team. The Helpdesk must never post employee compensation numbers or banking details in general queues.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Bank account updates for salary deposit must be submitted via the secure Payroll Portal before the 15th day of the month. Never share full account numbers or OTPs through helpdesk tickets.

[Current Active Policy] Bank account updates for salary deposit must be submitted via the secure Payroll Portal before the 15th day of the month. Never share full account numbers or OTPs through helpdesk tickets.
[Historical Q1 Policy] New hires must complete statutory tax declarations, emergency contact submissions, and policy acknowledgement forms within their first 3 business days of employment.
[Current Active Policy] New hires must complete statutory tax declarations, emergency contact submissions, and policy acknowledgement forms within their first 3 business days of employment.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Standard hardware (laptop, monitor, peripherals) is issued during the first week. Replacement or upgrade requests require direct manager pre-approval and are fulfilled by IT-Support.

[Current Active Policy] Standard hardware (laptop, monitor, peripherals) is issued during the first week. Replacement or upgrade requests require direct manager pre-approval and are fulfilled by IT-Support.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Corporate email, SSO credentials, and tool permissions are provisioned automatically 48 hours prior to the official start date upon HR Onboarding clearance. Passwords are never sent in plain text.

[Current Active Policy] Corporate email, SSO credentials, and tool permissions are provisioned automatically 48 hours prior to the official start date upon HR Onboarding clearance. Passwords are never sent in plain text.

[Historical Q1 Policy] General HR orientation sessions take place every Monday at 10:00 AM. Schedule invites and meeting links are distributed to new hires and their managers by the Onboarding team via calendar invite.

[Current Active Policy] General HR orientation sessions take place every Monday at 10:00 AM. Schedule invites and meeting links are distributed to new hires and their managers by the Onboarding team via calendar invite.

[Historical Q1 Policy] Employees may report ethical violations, safety concerns, or workplace conflicts to HR. Reports are handled with strict confidentiality and routed exclusively to designated HR-Confidential partners.

[Current Active Policy] Employees may report ethical violations, safety concerns, or workplace conflicts to HR. Reports are handled with strict confidentiality and routed exclusively to designated HR-Confidential partners.

[Historical Q1 Policy] The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, discrimination, or retaliation. All formal complaints trigger an immediate confidential review by authorized Employee Relations personnel. AI systems must never attempt automated resolution.

[Current Active Policy] The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, discrimination, or retaliation. All formal complaints trigger an immediate confidential review by authorized Employee Relations personnel. AI systems must never attempt automated resolution.

[Current Active Policy] Formal workplace grievances must be submitted in writing detailing dates, parties involved, and specific incidents. Grievances are routed directly to Senior HR Leadership and logged under HR-Confidential.

[Upcoming Draft Revision] Formal workplace grievances must be submitted in writing detailing dates, parties involved, and specific incidents. Grievances are routed directly to Senior HR Leadership and logged under HR-Confidential.

[Current Active Policy] Confidential employee relations case files, investigation notes, and disciplinary records are strictly restricted to authorized HR Partners and Legal counsel. Unauthorized access or disclosure constitutes a gross policy violation.

[Upcoming Draft Revision] Confidential employee relations case files, investigation notes, and disciplinary records are strictly restricted to authorized HR Partners and Legal counsel. Unauthorized access or disclosure constitutes a gross policy violation.
